head.t: AJM Healthcare's NW London wheelchair service on a Contract Performance Notice over long waits
head.x: NHS North West London wheelchair services, run by AJM Healthcare across Ealing and six other boroughs, have been under a Contract Performance Notice since December 2025. The ICB meets AJM fortnightly on a recovery plan; 1,380 open adult and child cases were reported at 5 August 2026.

head.t: Framework ending 8 June 2027: Wheelchairs, Specialist Seating and Related Services
head.x: Named on NHS Supply Chain's own contract launch brief for this framework, as "AJ Mobility Ltd" (Lot 1, Lot 2). 31 suppliers on the framework.
